structured_output.what_is_happening: DINOSAUR is a generic dinosaur-named token about 36 minutes old. It launched straight into a PumpSwap pool 3 seconds after the mint was created (no pump.fun bonding curve, migrated_unix=0). It traded about $570k in its first hour on a ~$31k market cap. The pool holds $51.6k of liquidity, which is more than the market cap. LP is 100% unlocked and not burned, and GMGN shows creator_close. GMGN tags 1,000 of 1,114 holders as fresh wallets. GeckoTerminal shows 1,128 unique buyers against only 120 unique sellers, with 461 of those buyers arriving in the last 30 minutes. That fits an airdropped or wallet-farm holder count more than organic demand. Momentum is already rolling over: m5 is -3% to -12% and GeckoTerminal m15 is -6%. I found no socials, no website and no web or X mentions.

narrative.description: A generic 'Dinosaur' meme with no identified trigger. There is routine paleontology news (e.g. an early-dinosaur fossil from Tanzania) but nothing viral that I could tie to the token.
narrative.why_spreading: No organic reason found. Volume seems driven by fresh-wallet trading, not by any narrative.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the only DINOSAUR token with live volume. The other same-name tokens are dead, but there is no narrative that makes any of them canonical.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Three older, dead tokens: Fucking Dinosaur, Dino/Dinosaur, and Fuckin' Dinosaur, each at roughly $2-3k market cap with zero volume.

authenticity.evidence: 1,000 of 1,114 holders are fresh wallets (GMGN), and there are 85 bundler wallets holding a 13% top-bundler share. Unique buyers outnumber unique sellers 1,128 to 120. There are no socials and no web presence. Hourly volume is 18x market cap. The pool was launched directly with liquidity larger than the market cap and the LP left unlocked.
authenticity.uncertainty: I have no X data, and private Telegram call groups would be invisible to me.

structural_risks: 100% of the LP is unlocked and was deployed by the creator, so it can be pulled at any time
Holder base is dominated by fresh wallets, i.e. likely farmed
Price is already fading from its ATH ($3.81e-5 vs $3.08e-5 now)

structured_output.counterargument: Real flow is large: about 3,300 buys in an hour and $570k of volume. The top-10 holders own only about 4% of supply, and mint and freeze authority are both renounced. A $30k market cap needs only about $30k of net buying to double. If a call group or a trending listing picks it up, it could 2x quickly.
unknowns: Whether there is any X or Telegram promotion
Where the creator's funds came from
Whether the fresh-wallet volume is wash trading

source_coverage.notes: Searching the contract address returned nothing relevant. The ticker search found only generic memecoin lists. News search found only routine dinosaur science stories. DexScreener lists no socials. Reddit, Telegram and Discord were not searched because of the time limit.

structured_output.thesis: A farmed-looking launch straight into a PumpSwap pool with unlocked LP, no socials, no narrative and momentum already fading. Rug risk is high and the odds of a genuine run are low.
